system_type_map_action_invalid.why: homer-parity 03b: compare_system_types was asked for an action other than start or abort. The model's slip; it reads the message and retries with a valid action.

system_type_map_never_run.why: homer-parity 03b: reading or aborting a study's system type map before it was ever run. A sequencing slip; the assistant starts it with compare_system_types first.

axis_missing.why: homer-parity 03b: compare_system_types was started without both x_variable and y_variable. The model's slip; it names the two variables and retries.

system_map_preview_stale.why: homer-parity 03b: the base project, the request or the derived architectures and solve count changed between the confirmation card and the run of compare_system_types. The assistant shows a new card.

unknown_variable.why: homer-parity 03b: compare_system_types named a variable that is not one of the map's choices. The refusal lists the choices; the assistant picks one and retries.

axes_not_different.why: homer-parity 03b: compare_system_types was given the same variable on both axes. The assistant chooses two different variables and retries.

axis_values_invalid.why: homer-parity 03b: an axis of compare_system_types did not hold 2 to 5 different multipliers above 0 and at most 10. The assistant fixes the values and retries.

variable_not_in_network.why: homer-parity 03b: a variable of compare_system_types would change nothing in the project (no such asset, none the optimiser sizes, or a zero value). The assistant tells the user and offers another variable.

system_map_preview_unavailable.why: homer-parity 03b: the confirmation data for compare_system_types could not be built, so no card is shown. The assistant reports it and does not retry unchanged.

campaign_budget_invalid.why: homer-parity 03b: compare_system_types would queue more solves than one campaign allows (cells x architectures, at most 120). The refusal names the count; the assistant proposes fewer values or fewer architectures.
